name: Capstone - QA Watchdog and Defect Triage

meta.description: Scheduled data quality run against the deployed pipeline. On failure it triages the defect and reports. Does not regenerate the test suite - it runs the approved one.

nodes.name: Every 6 Hours
nodes.notes: Matches the 60-minute Silver freshness target loosely; tighten only if the business genuinely needs it, since every reduction costs warehouse credits.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ statement: "CALL CAPSTONE_AI_DLC.AGENTS.STAGE_QA('N8N', FALSE)", timeout: 900, database: 'CAPSTONE_AI_DLC', schema: 'AGENTS', warehouse: 'COMPUTE_WH', role: 'ACCOUNTADMIN' }) }}

nodes.name: Run Approved QA Suite
nodes.notes: P_REGENERATE = FALSE. A watchdog must run the suite a human approved, not invent a new one each cycle.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ statement: "CALL CAPSTONE_AI_DLC.AGENTS.STAGE_TRIAGE('CLEAN','N8N')", timeout: 600, database: 'CAPSTONE_AI_DLC', schema: 'AGENTS', warehouse: 'COMPUTE_WH', role: 'ACCOUNTADMIN' }) }}

nodes.name: Build Alert
nodes.notes: Replace the downstream no-op with a Slack, Teams or email node and wire it to this output. The alert deliberately states that triage is advisory.
